svg.title: Field Journal — music video style reference (c1-field-journal)
svg.desc: A naturalist's notebook, open flat. The line is the entry; what it names is sketched in pencil on the facing page while it is sung, and every find stays in the book. Frame is 1600x900; the strip below the frame is apparatus, not part of the film.
